secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs login session tokens. A development value is auto-generated; not an external credential.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth 2.0 Client ID. Redirect URI: https://8000-<your-sandbox-host>/api/auth/google/callback

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Client secret for the same Google OAuth client.

secrets.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Azure Portal → App registrations → Application (client) ID. Redirect URI: https://8000-<your-sandbox-host>/api/auth/microsoft/callback

secrets.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Client secret for the same Azure app registration.

secrets.name: FACEBOOK_APP_ID
secrets.description: Meta for Developers → Apps → App ID. Valid OAuth redirect URI: https://8000-<your-sandbox-host>/api/auth/facebook/callback

secrets.name: FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET
secrets.description: App secret for the same Meta app.
